'''Winsafra Jedi, Jedi everywhere, dont run away, they wont hurt you, i swear :P''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 7 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Plead My Case To The Senate
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Senate Winsafra LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

run away!
run away!
